description: One-paragraph summary: which generation, what's covered, what's NOT covered. Be honest about scope — 'partial' is fine, 'unvalidated' is fine.

validated_against.notes: What you actually tested. Be specific about which PIDs you verified, what method you used (held-state sweep, raw-hex diff, comparison against community ground truth), and what's still untested. Example: 'Verified example_pid DE bytes at idle (= 0x8000 ≈ 0 Nm) and during gentle acceleration (DE varies +200..+1500 Nm). Did NOT test regen, sustained cruise, or cold-start behavior.'
